gotchas: Signup is the Flying Blue enrolment on the shared Air France-KLM identity host, https://identity.airfranceklm.com/enrol/flyingblue (off this host; the same wizard klm.com uses). From wwws.airfrance.co.uk: header 'Flying Blue' -> /information/flyingblue -> 'Join Flying Blue'. /information/flying-blue (with a hyphen) is a 404 on Air France.
Cookie wall on load: click button:has-text("Reject").

One question per screen: the first screen is 'Hi there! What is your name?' (first and last name exactly as on passport/ID; input[formcontrolname="firstName"] / input[formcontrolname="lastName"]) with a Continue button that stays disabled until both are filled. Inputs have no name/id/autocomplete attributes. Later screens (email, password, DOB etc.) were not observed.
